player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan iku Pemain {player_id} main permainan Dam karo {color}.
Gawe laku sampeyan ing notasi gaya catur [fileRank fileRank], contone '[b2c3]' (huruf kolom a–h, angka baris 0–7).
Aturan dasar:
  • Laku miring ngarep sak langkah yen kosong.
  • Nangkap kanthi melompati watu lawan.
  • Watu dadi Raja yen tekan pucuk sing berlawanan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ora ana format laku sing bener. Gunakake [a1b2], contone [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Abang ora duwe potongan sing isih ana. Ireng menang!
